workPackage: PR #14 critical fixes — resolution isolation, stateless simulation, camera-faithful replay

orchestration.reason: the tiered subagent models named in the work package are not addressable as separate agents in this environment

A.before: resolveWorld cached the whole ResolvedProject, so two characters sharing one animation set shared one modelAssetPath, capsule and identity
A.after: resolution splits into a shared ResolvedAnimationBundle and a per-character ResolvedProject wrapper; the cache holds bundles
A.replacementTest: shares immutable animation bundle members without sharing resolved project wrappers

B.before: world.preview advanced a per-request runtime and world.read_observations read a fresh one at tick zero; the advertised sequence was false over HTTP
B.after: world.simulate is stateless and returns the final observation and deterministic hash in the same response; world.preview removed; world.read_observations refused over HTTP

C.before: WorldReplayRecorder wrote cameraYawRad 0 and playback bound no control source, so a recording made while the camera turned replayed a different path
C.after: tick-keyed change-only camera-yaw control track sampled before each tick; createReplayRuntime binds it automatically
C.versionPolicy: v1 read explicitly as constant zero yaw; every other version refused by name

legacyReplay: byte-identical on all four committed fixtures; no baseline regenerated
renderCadence: identical world trace and hash at 30, 60 and 120 Hz
repositoryByteIntegrity: projects/demo-character/project.json, schemas/** and generated/** unchanged by this pass
knownLimitations: orchestration not followed; gate reviews are self-reviews
the browser samples camera yaw once per frame, so two ticks share a yaw at 30Hz; inherent to frame-sampled continuous input
RuntimeInstanceOverrides.moveSpeedScale still declared and unread (out of scope)
setFocusedInstance/setCameraTargetInstance still bypass the command registry (out of scope)
world viewport still renders the procedural character on a flat plane
only local-input player index 0 is wired in the browser
no performance ceiling established for instance count
Unity gains DTOs and a seam, not world behaviour
mergeRecommendationReason: all three critical issues and every required regression pass; the work package allows MERGE only when latest-head Vercel is PASS, and this environment cannot verify the deployment
